h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Gopalpur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Gopalpur

items.pText: Gopalpur is a beach town on the Odisha coast, near Berhampur, with hotels and resorts facing the Bay of Bengal. A play area here has to live with salt air, sea breeze and the cyclones that sometimes come in from the bay. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment to hotels, resorts, schools and colonies along this coast from our factory in Vasai, about 1,260 km away.

For a beach property, the play area is often one of the first things families notice. We help you choose a piece that suits the setting and place it where parents can sit nearby, away from the pool and the beach path. Galvanised frames and roto-moulded plastic are the right materials so close to the sea. We send everything by road and install it with our own team or a dealer in eastern India.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Looking after equipment near the sea

c: Salt and sand are hard on moving parts. Rinse the equipment with fresh water regularly, especially swing hangers, spring riders and merry-go-round bearings. Sand blown onto slides acts like sandpaper, so brush it off before guests use them. Before the cyclone season, check that every bolt is tight and that grouted bases are sound. Rubber flooring keeps the play area firmer and cleaner than open sand.

items.q: Which play equipment suits a beach resort in Gopalpur?
items.a: Galvanised steel and roto-moulded pieces in a theme that fits the setting, such as our Kagzi paper boat and paper fish designs. Place them in sight of guest seating and away from the pool.

items.q: How should we prepare play equipment for a cyclone?
items.a: Check that every bolt is tight and the foundations are sound before the season. After a storm, inspect the equipment for damage before children use it again.

items.q: Do you deliver to the Odisha coast?
items.a: Yes. We send orders from Vasai to Gopalpur and other coastal towns in Odisha by road, and install them through our team or a dealer.
